cmapss.rul: training engine terminal cycle minus observation cycle
cmapss.as_of: native observation cycle; no calendar conversion
cmapss.recorded_time: terminal cycle for retrospectively available training labels
cmapss.official_test_rul: evaluator_only; never joined to observed features

synthetic.positive: confirmed event in (as_of, as_of + 24h] recorded by label cutoff
synthetic.negative: uninterrupted full follow-up recorded by label cutoff
